"""A simple greeting module."""

import os from pathlib import Path

def greet(name: str) -> str: """Return a greeting message.""" return f"Hello, {name}!"

class Greeter: """A greeter class."""

def __init__(self, prefix: str = "Hello") -> None: self.prefix = prefix

def greet(self, name: str) -> str: return f"{self.prefix}, {name}!"
